text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One morning, I see Oguri Cap assumedly
headed
to the academy, but as she
approaches, she
marches right past its
gate.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That was a close one. You're a real lifesaver... Yawn.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't fall asleep last night, so
instead of
sheep, I decided to count
takoyaki.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Then I counted taiyaki, and then carrots,
and
then hamburgers...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Before I knew it, it was morning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap looks sleep-deprived
throughout the
remainder of the day.
